CONFIDENTIAL.
SECRET

BOX No. 500,
CARDIFF.

Ref. Sub. 43/12. 26th July, 1944.

Dear Micklethwait,

With reference to your letter PF.6074/F.3.m., dated July 10th, I enclose a communication from the Chief Constable of Cardiff regarding Arthur William OLDAG @ John OLDAY.

Yours sincerely,

Captain G.E. Callaghan.
For Major A.E. Grant.

R.G. Micklethwait, Esq.,
F.3.,
OXFORD.
GEC/PMcD.
